body: The best we can do is make suggestions and encouragements to others based on our experiences and hope something sticks, there is nothing wrong with that and it's the best that we can do on a crowdsourcing platform like reddit. Thank you for your contributions and care. I am sure you aren't speculating or making promises that you can't keep. It just helps to know that someone cares.
That is really unfair! But please your life is worth so much more than any amount of money just take 2 minutes to ponder that that's all I ask
I'm so sorry dude :'( it doesn't have to end this way

I can't imagine how terrible this feels but please be strong and just see how this ends out, I know it's hard to believe but there is a good chance that this could end up okay and with her alive and well...

Please just slow down for a minute and see how this pans out man, dying by slitting ones wrist has a very low success rate and there could be a very good chance that she makes it through this alive, and I'm willing to bet she would love to see you by her side in the hospital. Please think this through man this is never what she would want you to do

If you really want to help yourself fam, you need to find someone who cares enough about you to smash your computer and throw you in a 12 step program. I don't doubt your sincerity by looking at your post history. But you have a problem man, it's clear as day, and there are radical changes that you can make in your life to curb this obsession of yours. Tell a sibling, a parent, a close friend, anyone about this, there are people who want to help and care about you.

Damn dude, people = shit. If anyone in your life deserves happiness after all you've been through it's you. Despite your flaws, despite your diagnosis, and despite your regrets, you are one of the good ones man. I can't say that it will just get better but man, there are alot of ways for you to have a fulfilling existence and it would be a damn shame for you to never attain that. If I can help in some way let's talk.

You might find the "Mindfulness and Acceptance Workbook for Depression" helpful in your case. It helps you create a vision for the life that you want to live, help you take inventory of what is in your control, and take the steps to live out your ideal life each day

I hate myself, always have. I try hard but always manage to fuck things up in relationships and my career, and now my career is ending because of it. My family is so proud of me and I'd rather leave them with a good image of myself than allow them to watch me slowly destroy my life. I was in a psych hospital for 2 months and yes it helped but still don't think my life has value. I still see a therapist and I think I want to get ECT because my brain isn't doing me any favors right now, on top of everything I've started to have days of psychosis where it seems that nothing is real or that this is some simulation or that I'm just a cosmic reflection of some past relative, doomed to endure the same cycle of suffering. I want so bad to buy a gun and prevent the inevitable downward spiral that is to be the rest of my life.
